steps.en: Review page has a Back button
Back returns to the form with values still filled
steps.id: Back kembali ke form dengan nilai tetap terisi

steps.en: Edits are kept for the final submission
steps.why_en: Edits are kept only in the browser; there is no Save button or saved draft on the system.
steps.why_id: Perubahan hanya disimpan di browser; tidak ada tombol Save atau draft tersimpan di sistem.

steps.en: Re-checked data shows in a refreshed summary
steps.id: Data yang dicek ulang tampil di summary yang diperbarui
